messages:
emma: Quick postmortem follow-up: ACME on-prem peering outage. Need owners for remediation, short timelines, and a clear validation plan.
raj: Ill take the peering ACL and routing-table changes. blockers: need customer routing creds + infra oncall signoff.
nina: I'll own the isolation repro harness and validate the patch in the lab. Target: minimal repro + test cases by Thu.
tom: Security/compliance review required for any route-advert changes. Ill do a 30-min review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Please attach ACL diffs.
leah: Coordinating with ACME for the maintenance window. They gave a 2-hour window next Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Can we finish canary and rollback plan before that?
raj: Realistic: canary ready for Wed 01:30 UTC if creds arrive today. Otherwise we push one week. Adding ticket https://r-internal/tracker/INC-ACME-77 and setting ETA 2026-04-14 for final close.
infra-bot: Temporary access token issued to raj (scope: route-read, route-update). Expires in 36h.
nina: Repro notes: failure triggered when onprem NAT + asymmetric egress path causes BGP keepalive drops. I'll add a synthetic traffic test that emulates NAT mapping churn.
tom: ACL draft attached to tracker. Snippet:
```
# proposed peering ACL
permit tcp 172.31.0.0/16 any eq 179
deny ip any 172.31.0.0/16
```
Please review.
emma: Action items recap:
- Raj: implement ACL + routing tweak, owner, ETA Wed maintenance window
- Nina: repro harness + test cases, owner, ETA Thu
- Tom: sec/compliance review, owner, meeting tomorrow
- Leah: customer coordination + BGP logs, owner, confirm window
Mark blocked if creds/window/sec approval missing.
raj: Noted. Will open PR for routing change and request infra oncall signoff.
oncall-bot: Oncall handoff reminder: infra oncall must approve any route changes 2h before maintenance.
leah: I requested ACME to stream BGP logs to our secure bucket during the window. They agreed.
nina: Also flagging that this matches "peering flap" pattern from earlier incidents. Recommend an "peering-flap" metric and an automated runbook snippet to escalate to SRE. I'll draft runbook page.
tom: Security: watch for accidental route leakage when we relax deny rules. Ill add extra verification step to the canary: validate only intended prefixes are announced.
emma: Good. Let's meet Fri 11:00 PT for owners sync and verify everything in tracker. Please update tracker status (blocked/in-progress/done) as you go. Closing condition: canary validated in prod & logs show no BGP resets for 24h after change.
